Numbered List Formatter

Turn lines into a numbered list — 1. 1) a. i. styles — with a custom start number.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste one item per line.
  2. Pick a style and start number.
  3. Press Format and copy the list.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which numbering styles are available?

1. , 1) , a. , A. , i. and I. numbering styles.

Can I start from a custom number?

Yes — set any start number (or letter) and the list counts up from there.

What happens to blank lines?

Blank lines are skipped; only non-empty lines get numbers.
